# Where to find Grafton Monsters in Fallout 76

**Used for:**

- Kill the Grafton Monster
- Kill huge creatures
- Kill a cryptid
- Take a Camera Picture of the Grafton Monster

**Grafton Monsters can drop the following items:**

### **__Fixed Spawns__**

__Fixed Spawns__

**Charleston Station**

From the fast travel point, follow the train tracks South until you get to the second red metal bridge. Face West and look up and down the river bed, generally, he is hanging around near the red bridge or he is playing with the molerats closer to the Poseidon Energy Plant WV-06.

**Summersville Dam**

From the spawn in location, face West and run forward. You will see a group of Scorched on your right. Kill the Scorched and keep following the river on your right. Just past the large broken boat, you will see the Grafton Monster spawn.

**Hemlock Holes**

From the fast travel point, face South and run over to the diner/building. Jump on top of the building and face SE. The Grafton Monster here likes to wander around and pick fights with any enemies in the area, so you might need to use VATS to find him.

Don't forget to loot the diner for salt, pepper, spices, and sugar.

### **__Random Spawns__**

__Random Spawns__

**Toxic Dried Lakebed**

1/2 chance to spawn in the middle of the Toxic Dried Lakebed.

**Whitesprings**

1/4 chance to spawn in the Whitesprings Resort carpark near the Sulphur Water Fountain and gazebo.

### **__Events and Pip-boy dailys__**

__Events and Pip-boy dailys__

**Grafton Day**

Guaranteed chance to spawn as the end boss.

When you fast travel to Grafton, providing the event isn't already on cool down (1 hour 18 mins), there is a 50% chance of Grafton Day event popping up for you.

**Primal Cuts (Toxic Valley)**

Spawns as the end boss.

**Project Paradise**

1/3 chance to spawn as the end boss.

**Spin the Wheel**

1/5 chance to spawn during the "Red" boss wave.

**Heart of the Swamp**

1/2 chance to spawn as the end boss.

**Queen of the Hunt**

1/6 chances to spawn at one of the Investigate sites.

This daily can first be started by visiting the __Hunter's Shack__ in The Mire. After you have completed the daily the first time, then it will trigger by just fast traveling into the region. Pip-Boy daily cool-down periods apply.

### **__Random Encounter Spawn Locations__**

__Random Encounter Spawn Locations__

__Whitesprings Assault Encounters__

Whitesprings Assault spawn __map__

__Travel Encounters__

Travel spawn __map__

**Wandering Grafton Boss**

Note: Because of the size of the Grafton Monster, he will only spawn at certain travel spawn points that have room for him to move around.
